mechanical_track_source: User reported measured wheel centre spacing 234 mm, 2026-10-20
notes: 2026-10-22: Startup comparison against user-confirmed A740 moving build. Increase PWM slew from 8 to 32/10ms and encoder no-pulse startup allowance from 200ms to 500ms; retain latched encoder fault after the grace period. Validate with wheels raised before ground testing. LD06 front appeared left in serial GUI; user confirmed GUI rotation +90 deg makes vertical board appear ahead with correct direction. For A741 clockwise raw angles inverted on display, equivalent zero offset is 270 deg. MPU module 3.3V user report; pullups/bank/pins and H14 USB_PA3 isolation remain unverified. User measured wheel track 234mm; wheel CPR/diameter provisional.
